basis: For SH-C-050 (Abandoned checkouts and recovery) against SA-C-048 (Abandoned carts): a join on role, a reading. Each platform gives the records of purchases the buyer began and didn't complete a place of its own: Shopify's admin route abandonedCheckouts at checkouts, gated by MANAGE_ABANDONED_CHECKOUTS, whose entitlement is abandonedCartRecovery (SH-S-5001, SH-S-5002); Salla's dashboard app @salla.sa/ui-merchant-abandoned_carts at /marketing/carts and its event abandoned.cart, سلة مشتريات متروكة (SA-S-3591, SA-S-1625). CM-CHK-007's cells cite all four. The terms differ (checkout against cart), and whether Shopify's records include carts left before checkout isn't stated (notes). The recovery side of both concerns is domain D's CM-MKT-022, whose cells cite SH-S-7224 and SA-S-2099. WC-C-105's pairs are for the WooCommerce part.

For SH-C-028 (Metafields and metaobjects) against SA-C-042 (Order options and custom fields at checkout): scope.tsv gives SH-C-028 domain E (also B, not C), so no capability here cites it; its metafields are E's CM-CNT-002. SA-C-042 lands in CM-CHK-009, whose Shopify cell is none-held. SA-C-020's pair is domain B's.

For SH-C-140 (Sell in AI chats, agentic commerce) against SA-C-100 (Checkout page and cart): scope.tsv gives SH-C-140 domain F (also E, not C). The candidate's ask is the Universal Commerce Protocol: Shopify's dev.ucp.shopping.checkout and Salla's flag ucp-embedded-checkout, not released. CM-CHK-001 cites both as shows only, SH-S-2530 under SH-C-047's key, which Q1 placed there too; agentic commerce is domain F's CM-AIA-005, which cites SH-S-2530 as core and leaves the Salla flag uncited (its note).

For SH-C-152 (Sidekick, AI assistant for commerce) against SA-C-100 (Checkout page and cart): scope.tsv gives SH-C-152 domain F. Sidekick is an AI-enabled commerce assistant in the admin (SH-S-0736); nothing in SA-C-100 is an assistant.

For SH-C-202 (Shopify Magic for product descriptions and blog posts) against SA-C-100 (Checkout page and cart): scope.tsv gives SH-C-202 domain F (also B and E, not C). Magic writes product descriptions in the admin (SH-S-7203); nothing in SA-C-100 generates content.

For SH-C-055 (Draft orders) against SA-C-040 (Orders): a join on role, a reading. Shopify's route draftOrders:new is titled Create order and sits in its section Orders, gated by CREATE_AND_EDIT_DRAFT_ORDERS (SH-S-7094, SH-S-5214); Salla's plan line is إنشاء طلب يدوي, create a manual order, with the staff permission order_create (SA-S-1989, SA-S-2273). CM-ORD-005's cells cite all four. Whether Salla's manual order has a draft stage isn't stated. SA-C-040's price-quote keys (SA-S-2288, SA-S-3361) are domain D's CM-B2B-004. The pair SH-C-055 against SA-C-126 (payment links) is left to the PAY batch, which lands SA-C-126.

For SH-C-061 (Order and product printing) against SA-C-044 (Order invoices issued by the store): a join on role, a reading. CM-ORD-008's cells cite Shopify's App Store category Invoice and receipt apps, which Q1 placed in SH-C-061 (SH-I-1854), and Salla's Invoice settings and order invoice printing (SA-S-1778, SA-S-1987). The rest of SH-C-061, its packing slip and document templates, lands in CM-ORD-009, and Salla's invoices are not packing slips: Salla's stated aim for its invoice settings is the invoice's contents and its serial numbers (SA-S-5015). The admin print action is domain F's CM-APP-008.

For SH-C-052 (Cart and checkout validation) against SA-C-047 (Order acceptance rules): Shopify's App Store category Order limit apps (SH-I-1816), which Q1 placed in SH-C-052, is undefined: no Shopify statement held says what those apps limit. Salla's تعيين الحد اليومي للطلبات (SA-S-1992) and flag receiving-orders-limit (SA-S-3270) set a daily limit on the orders a store receives. Batch 1 cites SH-I-1816 in CM-CHK-005 (validation); CM-ORD-010 cites Salla's keys. No capability cites both, and the shared words "order limit" don't show the same object.

For SH-C-064 (Payment processing and settlement for Shopify Payments) against SA-C-235 (What happens when a payment, shipping or other partner is unavailable): scope.tsv gives SA-C-235 domain G, which names C under also, so the ruling follows the cells. Shopify's statements are the substitution of a Payment Processor behind Shopify Payments (SH-S-0085, SH-S-0116), cited in CM-PAY-004. Salla's statement is its exemption from liability where affiliate commissions stop being calculated after payment-gateway updates (SA-S-0044), landed in domain G's CM-OPS-001. No capability cites both: CM-PAY-004's Salla cell doesn't cite SA-C-235, whose subject is commissions, not the processor behind Salla Payments.

For SH-C-074 (Shop Pay) against SA-C-079 (Quick checkout): a finer part of a coarser thing, a reading. Shopify's Shop Pay Merchant Terms put Shop Pay under "1. Accelerated Checkout (Shop Pay)" (SH-S-0413), and Shop Pay saves the buyer's details to make checkout "faster and more convenient" (SH-S-0406); CM-PAY-014 cites them, and its parent CM-CHK-008 cites Salla's quick checkout, its link at /marketing/quick_checkout (SA-S-1824) and its stated reason, reducing and speeding up the steps of completing the order (SA-S-5027). CM-CHK-008 doesn't cite SH-C-074's keys, and CM-PAY-014 doesn't cite SA-C-079's: Salla's statements don't say what quick purchase rests on, so it isn't shown to save the buyer's details.
